info.title: dotllm
info.description: Command-line tool for dotLLM — run, chat, serve, and manage GGUF models. Install with: dotnet tool install -g DotLLM.Cli

options.name: --device
options.description:
auto       Compute device: 'auto' (default: CUDA if
the model fits, else Vulkan, else CPU -
with a warning if it ends on the CPU),
'cpu', 'vulkan', 'gpu'/'cuda',
'gpu:1'/'cuda:1'. An explicit GPU that
cannot be honoured is an error, never a
silent CPU run

options.description:

rep runs first and is discarded)

options.description:
0          Extra synthetic context tokens fed
(untimed) after prefill, before the timed
decode. Decode runs at context depth p +
depth

options.description: Seed text tiled to synthesize the prompt

options.description:
Quantization filter when multiple GGUF
files exist (e.g., Q4_K_M, Q8_0)

options.description:
0          Number of CPU threads for inference. 0 =
auto/all cores (default)

options.name: --decode-threads
options.description:
0          Number of threads for decode. 0 = auto
(caps at memory channel count)

options.name: --json
options.description:
Output result as a single JSON object
(suppresses all formatted output)

options.name: --n-cpu-moe
options.description:
0          MoE CPU/GPU expert offload (#370,
llama.cpp --n-cpu-moe equivalent, Vulkan
Qwen3MoeHybrid only): put the first N MoE
layers' routed experts on the CPU instead
of the GPU, trading decode/prefill
throughput for reduced device memory. 0 =
fully GPU-resident/streaming (default).
No-op on cpu/cuda backends or
non-Qwen3MoeHybrid Vulkan models

commands.description: Compute perplexity over a text corpus.

options.name: --corpus
options.description:
Path to a UTF-8 text
corpus (e.g.
wiki.test.raw)

options.name: --normalize-line-endings
options.description:
Collapse CRLF to LF while
reading --corpus, as MSVC
text mode does. OFF by
default. Use ONLY when the
reference figure came from
a Windows llama.cpp build
reading the same CRLF
file; llama.cpp on Linux
keeps the CRs, so
normalizing there creates
a mismatch. Preferred fix
is an LF corpus (see
docs/PERPLEXITY.md, issue
#506)

options.name: --unscored-prefix
options.description:
Leading tokens of each
window used as context
only. -1 selects context/2
(llama.cpp's default)

options.name: --max-tokens
options.description:

consumed. 0 = unbounded

implementation
